find_artworks_by_artist.description: List everything one artist made, by name: no ID lookup first. The name is resolved to the museum's own artist record and the collection is then filtered on that person, so 'Monet' returns his paintings rather than every work whose catalogue text mentions him. Whoever the name resolved to is reported back as 'artist_name', with any other artists of that name under 'other_matches'.

search_artworks.description: Search the museum's collection of more than 130,000 objects. Every filter is optional and they combine: narrow by kind of object, where it was made, its subject or style, when it was made and which room it hangs in, and keep only the works on view, the ones in the public domain, or the ones the museum has photographed. Returns full catalogue records with ready-to-use image links, the number of matches, and the offset for the next page. Leave the search words empty to browse by filters alone.

description: Search and browse the Art Institute of Chicago's collection of more than 130,000 works through its public API. Find artworks by subject, artist, place, period, medium or gallery; pull a full catalogue record with ready-to-use image links; look up an artist; see which exhibitions are on and what is happening at the museum this week; and check the opening hours. No account or API key is required.
